defs: Optimizer states
Extra per-parameter values an optimizer keeps (Adam: momentum and variance).
Activations
Forward-pass values saved for the backward pass.
Activation checkpointing
Store only some activations and recompute the rest during backward.
Mixed precision
16-bit compute and storage with an fp32 master copy of weights.
Loss scaling
Multiply the loss by S before backprop to avoid fp16 underflow; divide after.
bf16
16-bit format with fp32's 8-bit exponent and a 7-bit mantissa.
ZeRO / FSDP
Shard optimizer states, gradients and weights across GPUs.
FlashAttention
IO-aware, tiled exact attention with an online softmax.
Online softmax
Running max and sum, rescaled when a larger score appears.
Ring Attention
Sequence split across devices; K/V blocks circulate in a ring.

recall.minute: GPU memory during training holds weights, gradients, optimizer states and activations. Adam in fp32: 4 + 4 + 8 = 16 B/param, so 1B params ≈ 16 GB and 70B ≈ 1.1 TB before activations; ZeRO/FSDP shard this. Activations ≈ 34·s·b·h·L bytes in 16-bit (seq 2048, batch 8, h 4096, 32 layers ≈ 73 GB); checkpointing recomputes them. Mixed precision: 16-bit forward/backward (halves activations, fast tensor cores), fp32 master weights, loss scaling (fp16 underflows below ~6×10⁻⁸; a 10⁻⁸ gradient survives with S = 2¹⁰); with Adam the weight-side bill stays 2 + 2 + 4 + 8 = 16 B/param. bf16 keeps fp32 range. Attention computes an n × n matrix: n = 2000 costs 4× n = 1000; 128k tokens → ~33 GB per head per layer in fp16. FlashAttention tiles Q, K, V into SRAM with an online softmax ([2, 1, 3, 0] → ℓ = 1.553 either way): exact, fewer memory trips, O(n) memory. Ring Attention circulates K/V blocks among P devices (P − 1 passes), so context scales with devices; work stays O(n²). Sparse, sliding-window (n·w) and linear (n·d) attention cut the work at some quality cost.
